guarantees.claim: data_in_prev_we is continuously assigned to the bit of sp2v_sig_chk at index NumSharesKey * NumRegsKey + NumSlicesCtr + 0.
data_out_we is continuously assigned to the bit of sp2v_sig_chk at index NumSharesKey * NumRegsKey + NumSlicesCtr + 1.
sp_enc_err_d is the OR-reduction of the entire sp2v_sig_err bus, asserting high whenever any sparse-encoding error signal is active.

assumptions.claim: The bits of sp2v_sig_chk used for data_in_prev_we and data_out_we are properly driven by upstream sparse-encoding checker modules and reflect the intended write-enable signals.
assumptions.risk: If misconnected or driven incorrectly, data write enables may be erroneous, leading to data corruption or security bypass in the AES data path.

assumptions.claim: The sp2v_sig_err bus correctly aggregates all sparse-encoding error indicator signals from across the AES core as intended.
assumptions.risk: Missing or incorrect error signals will cause sp_enc_err_d to fail to detect encoding errors, potentially allowing corrupted data to propagate unnoticed.

uncertain_points.claim: The computed index NumSharesKey * NumRegsKey + NumSlicesCtr + 1 may exceed the declared width of sp2v_sig_chk, causing an out-of-bounds read on security-critical write-enable assignment.
uncertain_points.risk: Undefined bit values could be assigned to data_in_prev_we or data_out_we, leading to unauthorized writes or data integrity violations.

uncertain_points.claim: sp_enc_err_d is a combinational OR of potentially asynchronous error sources; glitches may occur if sp2v_sig_err changes transiently, causing unreliable error capture by downstream logic.
uncertain_points.cond: whenever any bit of sp2v_sig_err toggles asynchronously
uncertain_points.risk: A glitchy sp_enc_err_d may be sampled as a false error or missed, reducing the reliability of the error reporting mechanism.

uncertain_points.claim: The exact mapping of sp2v_sig_chk bits to data_in_prev_we and data_out_we depends on the ordering of checker module instantiations and the values of NumSharesKey, NumRegsKey, NumSlicesCtr; verification must confirm the intended control signals are accessed.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect mapping could swap write-enable signals or connect an unrelated checker output, undermining the sparse-encoding protection scheme.
